Content inside <noscript> only renders with scripting disabled and must not appear in the output

```rust title="Rust"
use html_to_markdown_rs::convert;
use html_to_markdown_rs::ConversionOptions;

fn main() {
    let html = r#"<p>visible</p><noscript><p>secret noscript text</p></noscript><p>also visible</p>"#;
    let options: ConversionOptions = Default::default();
    let _ = convert(html, Some(options.clone()));
    println!("{:?}", result.content);
}
```
